question: Does the complete union of all five coprime-selector sectors reduce charged M31 RR5 extraction work relative to the coupled formulation on the same canonical B677 public targets under matched total budgets?
decision_value: A complete, independently checked reduction in total extraction work at equal useful-relation output would justify integrating the sector formulation into the maintained solver. A smaller individual system, an incomplete sector union, a timeout, or a comparison that renews the budget per sector would not justify that decision. Null and negative results determine whether to retain the coupled reference.
